resources.string: Full-screen touch blocker with an edge overlay toggle button.
Overlay permission is required to place the edge button and block screen touches.

If the toggle is grayed out (Restricted setting / Advanced Protection): tap Open App Info below, tap the 3-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner, and select \"Allow restricted settings\", or grant via ADB.
Open App Info (⋮ → Allow Restricted Settings)
Edge overlay button is currently stopped.
Edge button active on screen edge (Screen Unlocked).
Screen Touch Locked — Tap the edge button to unlock.
Require double-tap on edge button to unlock
Default Screen Edge Position (also draggable vertically)
Touch Locked — Tap edge button to unlock
Screen touch is locked. Use the edge button to unlock.
Tap edge button once more to unlock
Keeps the edge toggle button and touch blocker active over other apps.
All screen touches blocked. Tap edge button or notification action to unlock.
Edge button is docked on screen. Tap it anytime to lock screen touch.
